points.why: It says the vague instruction yields a meaningless verdict and asks for an explicit list of failable requirements: page and word limits, fonts, margins, required sections in order, budget rules, eligibility and attachments.
It asks which files and pages the agent actually opened and for per-chapter coverage, but never says to build the check inventory from the proposal's own chapters, appendices, budget and attachments.
It treats the bare 'complies' as unauditable, has a person verify disqualifying items against the funder's own checklist, and asks for cited guideline text and a check for outdated guidelines.
It adds scripted layout and count checks and a planted-error test, but never recomputes narrative figures against the budget spreadsheet or opens every attachment and link.

pitfalls.why: The rerun it proposes uses per-requirement evidence and scripts, and it never asks the agent whether it is sure.
